rationale_summary: The guidebook's dominant frame is innovation_enablement because its overarching purpose is to promote safe, appropriate adoption and coexistence with generative AI across Japan's game, anime, and advertising industries by providing practical voluntary guidance, real-world use cases, and legal risk-mitigation measures that unlock workflow efficiency and new creative possibilities. While fundamental_rights is a strong runner-up—since the guidebook's operational cautions focus heavily on protecting creators' and individuals' intellectual property rights, personality/portrait rights, publicity rights, and personal-data privacy—innovation_enablement edges it out because rights compliance is explicitly positioned as the means to dispel stakeholder concerns and enable constructive AI utilization rather than as a standalone rights-enforcement regime. Minor secondary touches of economic_competitiveness (the parent overseas-expansion project and references to industrial development), social_stability (brief mentions of misinformation and hallucinations), and consumer_public_safety (passing references to safety and consumer interests) appear without driving the document's core rationale.

evidence_spans.quote: 本ガイドブックは、コンテンツ制作に携わる産業界のみなさまに向けて、ゲーム・アニメ・広告の各産業における生成A I の利活用ケースと、各活用シーンにおける留意点・対応策を紹介し、知的財産権等の権利・利益の保護に十分に配慮した、コンテンツ制作における生成A Iの適切な利活用の方向性をお示しするものです。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Directed at industry stakeholders involved in content creation, this guidebook introduces generative AI utilization cases in the game, anime, and advertising industries along with points of attention and countermeasures for each usage scene, indicating a direction for the appropriate utilization of generative AI in content creation with sufficient consideration for the protection of rights and interests such as intellectual property rights.
